card.name: Linking words in burden and harm statistics
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of" or "by" right after a quantity or cause term ("proportion", "percent", "leading cause") in sentences about disease burden, deaths or toxic effects. Also number pieces and words inside severe-reaction phrases.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that continue a count or harm statement, and away from casualty-count words like deaths and casualties.
card.plain: It fires on small words in sentences giving how many people are affected or harmed by a disease or reaction.
